description: Animation and VFX task routing defaults. Values are policy inputs, not project-specific constants.

metrics.N: candidate animation and VFX resource count
metrics.C: write-conflict edge count between ready tasks
metrics.R: runtime-dependent effect groups such as custom shaders, VFX Graph, particles, or ocean simulation

large.when: any metric exceeds the mid threshold

forbidden_boundaries: random path range that splits a dependency closure
multiple writers targeting one final manifest or launcher
multiple adapters guessing the same unknown signature

concurrency.work_units_formula: max(1, ceil(N / shard_items), ceil(B / shard_bytes), G, U, R)
concurrency.dependency_rule: only nodes whose predecessors are approved may become ready
concurrency.unknown_rule: any U greater than zero creates exactly one Adapter task per unknown format-signature group before full export of that group
concurrency.write_conflict_rule: any C greater than zero removes conflicting nodes from the same concurrent wave unless each writer uses an isolated task fragment
concurrency.pipeline_rule: Preview may consume an immutable approved export fragment while later independent Exporter shards continue, but final manifest and launcher publication wait for Merger

Discovery.trigger: always as a logical node; use a separate agent when U>0, G>1, dependency identity is missing, or the workload is not small
Discovery.gate: candidate counts, bytes, signatures, source hashes, dependency edges, ambiguity, and unknown groups reconcile

Adapter.trigger: U>0, unsupported inputs exist, stable preview IR is missing, or runtime component coverage is incomplete
Adapter.gate: a representative sample starts RED, then parses or reconstructs repeatably; malformed data fails closed; limitations are machine-readable; Spec approves before full export

Exporter.trigger: an Adapter or known converter is Spec-approved
Exporter.gate: planned candidates equal exported plus skipped plus failed; provenance and output hashes exist; rerun is idempotent; source remains unchanged

Preview.trigger: an immutable export fragment contains at least one preview-ready item
Preview.scope: consume manifest data rather than rediscovering source files
Preview.gate: playback, material inspection, media export, partial and unsupported states, and source location are represented without placeholders being marked complete

Merger.trigger: all required fragments for the publication generation are closed
Merger.scope: final manifest, errors index, preview launcher, and publication summary
Merger.gate: fragment exact set, schema version, dependency references, generation hashes, and final paths reconcile

Spec.trigger: after Discovery, Adapter, Exporter, Preview, or Merger reports DONE or DONE_WITH_CONCERNS
Spec.gate: scope, dependency order, write ownership, exact-set counts, five-directory contract, provenance, and explicit incomplete states pass

Fixer.trigger: a Spec or Quality review fails
Fixer.gate: a new Fixer reproduces the supplied probe as RED, applies the minimal fix, and returns target plus regression evidence for re-review

Quality.gate: representative playback, transforms, timing, transparency and blending, dependency display, exported media decoding, offline safety, and source immutability pass

single_writer_targets: the same Skill source or reference file
fragment_requirements: task-id is unique within the analysis run
each fragment declares candidate exact set and generation hash
fragments never publish the final launcher
Merger is the only final publisher

klei.conversion_rule: Klei package conversion is serial and single-producer because shared converter outputs and package indices must not be written concurrently
